Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
